backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a local marketplace platform with user profiles, shops, products, orders, support tickets, and return requests, including role-based access control (customer/shopkeeper/admin) and blob storage integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including authentication with three role types, customer portal with location-based shop browsing, category-based product search, shopping cart, checkout with 2% commission, order tracking, and admin/shopkeeper management portals.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON summary of frontend components describing customer, shopkeeper, and admin portal pages with order management, product browsing, inventory management, analytics, and ticket support functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode color tokens for the marketplace theme including Trust-Blue and Success-Green colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Local Market Hub application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component using TanStack Router to define all routes for customer, shopkeeper, and admin portals with authentication, profile setup modal, and loading states.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button component using Internet Identity authentication with loading states and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup allowing users to enter their name and select a role (customer, shopkeeper, or admin).
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleGuard.t: A React component that restricts access to child components based on user roles (customer, shopkeeper, admin), displaying loading states, authentication prompts, or access denied messages as needed.
frontend/src/components/customer/CartIte: Displays a single cart item with product image, name, price, and quantity controls (increment, decrement, remove) that update the cart via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/customer/CartSid: A slide-out sheet component showing the shopping cart with items, total price, and a checkout button, accessible via a floating action button with item count badge.
frontend/src/components/customer/OrderCa: Displays order details in a card format with status badge, expandable item list, and a return request button for delivered orders.
frontend/src/components/customer/Product: Shows a product card with image, name, description, price, stock status, category badge, and an 'Add to Cart' button.
frontend/src/components/customer/ReturnR: A modal dialog for submitting return/exchange requests with a reason dropdown and optional description textarea.
frontend/src/components/customer/ShopCar: Displays a shop card with name, location, online status badge, and a button to navigate to the shop's products.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout with a sticky header containing role-based navigation links, mobile menu toggle, login button, and renders CartSidebar for customers.
frontend/src/components/shared/CreateTic: Modal dialog component for creating support tickets with a textarea for issue description and form submission handling using the useCreateSupportTicket hook.
frontend/src/components/shopkeeper/Inven: Card component displaying product inventory details with edit and delete actions, showing product image, name, description, price, stock quantity, and category badge.
frontend/src/components/shopkeeper/Produ: Modal form component for adding or editing products with fields for name, description, price, quantity, category selection, and image upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/shopkeeper/ShopO: Card component displaying order details for shopkeepers with status badges and action buttons to update order status through different workflow stages (pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Authentication hook that combines Internet Identity and actor state to provide user authentication status and profile data through React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flows, identity state, and delegation validity with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including products, shops, cart, orders, support tickets, and admin functions. Provides both query hooks (useGetProducts, useGetShops, etc.) and mutation hooks (useAddToCart, useCheckout, useApproveShop, etc.) with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components (background, foreground, primary, secondary, etc.) and custom trust-blue and success-green color schemes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Admin dashboard displaying platform statistics including total shops, orders, revenue, and pending tickets with role-based access control.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AnalyticsPage.t: Admin analytics page showing platform sales metrics, commission tracking (2%), and total orders with placeholder for subscription tracking feature.
frontend/src/pages/admin/SettingsPage.ts: Admin settings page with placeholder for future platform-wide configuration options.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ShopManagementP: Admin shop management interface with tabs for pending and approved shops, allowing admins to review and approve shop registrations.
frontend/src/pages/admin/TicketsPage.tsx: Admin page for managing support tickets with tabs for open, in-progress, and resolved tickets. Allows admins to update ticket status and view ticket details.
frontend/src/pages/customer/CheckoutPage: Customer checkout page displaying cart items with product details, calculates subtotal with 2% commission, and handles order placement with navigation to orders page.
frontend/src/pages/customer/MyOrdersPage: Customer page displaying all orders sorted by timestamp with refresh functionality. Shows empty state when no orders exist.
frontend/src/pages/customer/MyTicketsPag: Customer/shopkeeper page for viewing support tickets with a button to create new tickets via modal. Currently shows empty state placeholder.
frontend/src/pages/customer/ProductBrows: Customer page for browsing products with category filtering. Displays available products in a grid layout with empty states for no results.
frontend/src/pages/customer/ReturnReques: Customer page for viewing return requests. Currently displays only an empty state placeholder.
frontend/src/pages/customer/ShopBrowsePa: Customer page for browsing local shops with location-based search functionality. Displays approved and open shops in a grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero banner and three-portal overview (customer, shopkeeper, admin), featuring role-based navigation that redirects authenticated users to their appropriate dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/shopkeeper/InventoryP: Shopkeeper page for managing product inventory with add/edit functionality. Requires shop registration and admin approval before allowing product management.
frontend/src/pages/shopkeeper/LedgerPage: Shopkeeper ledger page displaying sales analytics including total sales, 2% platform commission, net earnings, and monthly breakdowns for completed/delivered orders.
frontend/src/pages/shopkeeper/OrdersPage: Shopkeeper orders management page that displays all shop orders sorted by timestamp with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/shopkeeper/ShopDashbo: Shop dashboard for registering new shops (name and location) and managing existing shop status (online/offline toggle) with admin approval workflow.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color palette (trust-blue, success-green), OKLCH color system, container settings, and animation keyframes for accordion components.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a hyperlocal marketplace with Customer/Shopkeeper/Admin roles, Motoko backend, manual location filtering, and known limitations (no real-time geolocation, push notifications, or live tracking).
